duration.text: The Stomatological Medicine at Central South University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK For Chinese-meidum programs.2.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)3.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included4.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant5.Undergraduate school transcript 6.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.7.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: Qulification1. Applicants with an educational background equal to a bachelor's degree in China2. Recommendation letters from two professors3. and have Band III certificate in HSK, or have studied Chinese for more than one year.
